part.name: Dual-fan automotive radiator assembly
part.description: A rectangular liquid-to-air heat exchanger with a perimeter frame, finned radiator core, two axial electric fan assemblies with protective guards, coolant hose fittings, and service or mounting plugs. CadQuery reports 20 solids: SOLID 0 is the large connected radiator/frame/fan-guard body, SOLID 1 through SOLID 14 are seven repeated blades for each of two fans, SOLID 15 and SOLID 16 are paired hose fittings, SOLID 17 and SOLID 18 are paired corner plugs or mounts, and SOLID 19 is a top filler/service cap. The STEP is reported as invalid, and several accessory solids are represented by single closed BSpline faces.
part.symmetry_note: The assembly is approximately bilateral about CAD z=0. Two fan centers occur near z=-133.35 mm and z=+133.35 mm. Each fan has a seven-member circular blade pattern. The accessory fittings break exact bilateral symmetry.

semantic_orientation.description: The guarded dual-fan side is interpreted as the front, the exposed heat-exchanger face as the back, the long header containing the filler/service cap as the top, and the opposite long header as the bottom. CAD view labels are mapped independently from this semantic interpretation.
